rules.title: Income rules
rules.intro1: Buckets with the refill mode “On income” aren't refilled when a new cycle starts. They wait until your income, such as your salary, arrives, so you only budget money you have.
rules.intro2: An income that matches a rule refills the “On income” buckets funded from the account it's paid into. To match, it must come from the counterparty (case doesn't matter) and be at least the minimum. Each bucket is refilled at most once per cycle, so a second payment in the same cycle doesn't refill it again.
rules.intro3: On each income you can also tick “Triggers refill” yourself, or untick it to skip a rule that matches.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Without rules, “On income” buckets are only refilled by an income where you tick “Triggers refill”.

budget.title: Savings budget
budget.intro: Fixed amounts to save each cycle, and sweeps of what's left. A fixed amount reserves its amount from the account's unallocated money, once a cycle, after the buckets refilled at the same moment; if the account has less, it reserves what's there and a notification says what's missing. A sweep saves what the account has unallocated above an amount to keep.

cycles.othersWait: Manual and On income buckets wait for their refill.
cycles.gapTitle: No active cycle in the gap

cycles.noneAfterTitle: No cycle planned after this one

cycles.previewNote: A preview: the amounts can change slightly, because the money is reallocated first.
cycles.ended: Cycle ended. There's no active cycle until you start one.
cycles.sweptNote: What's unallocated then, with what the emptied buckets give back, above the amount to keep.

reports.noModules: No modules yet. Add one to build the report.
reports.previousFailed: The previous period couldn't be loaded.

templates.label: Report

breakdown.label: Breakdown

breakdown.short: A breakdown needs a period of at least {{days}} days.
breakdown.many: More than {{max}} parts. Choose a shorter period.

module.saveHint: It's saved over this report's period, with its filters. On the Stats tab you can show it over another period, such as the last 3 months, and put it on the Dashboard.
module.saved: Saved "{{name}}". Find it on the Stats tab.
module.savedMax: You have {{max}} saved modules, the most there can be. Delete one on the Stats tab first.
module.fromSavedHint: A copy, shown over the report's period. Changing it here doesn't change the saved module.
module.title: Title
module.titleHint: Optional. Without one, the module is named after what it shows.
module.max: A report has at most {{max}} modules.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.empty: No transactions in this period match.

sections.label: Sections
sections.hint: Each month or cycle of the period under its own heading, with a summary, on a new page in the PDF.
sections.many: More than {{max}} sections, so they're shown as one list.
sections.more: More to load before the summary

table.label: Transactions
table.columnsHint: Tick the columns to show and move them into order. Balance after shows only with exactly one account.

flows.title: In, out and balance
flows.filtersNote: The report's tags and counterparty don't apply to this module.
flows.balancesHint: Each account's balance at the start and end, with Other for opening balances, adjustments and transfers that aren't counted.
flows.detailsHint: Split in and out into refills, income, adjustments, transfers, spent and overflow.
flows.breakdownHint: Also a table or grid per month or cycle, for periods of at least {{days}} days.

budget.title: Budget vs spending
budget.summaryHint: Budget: what the buckets could spend, from the first cycle's start plus everything put in since, without what overflowed above a bucket's capacity. Carried over: what was left at the end of the last cycle.
budget.empty: No buckets had a budget in this cycle.
budget.none: No cycles have begun in this period.
budget.many: This period has more than {{max}} cycles. Choose a shorter one.
budget.filtersNote: The report's tags and counterparty don't apply to this module.
budget.hint: A cycle counts in the period that holds most of its days, and is shown whole. Planned cycles are left out. Unspent is the budget minus what was used; Carried over is what went into the next cycle, 0 for a bucket that doesn't keep its funds.
budget.perCycleHint: A table per cycle after the summary. Off: only the summary.

pdf.nothing: This page prints a report to PDF. Use Export PDF on a report.

unit.label: Repeat for
unit.hint: The section's modules are shown for each month or cycle of the report's period, at most {{max}}.

section.max: At most {{max}} modules in a section.
section.noModules: Add modules to repeat them for each month or cycle.
section.many: More than {{max}} months or cycles: choose a shorter period.
section.none: No months or cycles in this period.

builder.hint: The modules by title: preview one to see it, or switch to Full report to see them all.
builder.previewPart: Shown for {{part}}, the section's newest month or cycle.

average.label: Average
average.hint: Also the average per month or cycle, over the whole ones in the period.
average.budgetHint: Also the average budget, used and unspent per cycle, over the cycles that are over.

whole.month_one: The average is of {{count}} whole month; partial ones don't count.
whole.month_other: The average is of {{count}} whole months; partial ones don't count.
whole.cycle_one: The average is of {{count}} whole cycle; one still going doesn't count.
whole.cycle_other: The average is of {{count}} whole cycles; partial ones and one still going don't count.

average.budgetWhole_one: The average is of {{count}} cycle; one still going doesn't count.
average.budgetWhole_other: The average is of {{count}} cycles; one still going doesn't count.
average.many: Too many months or cycles to average: at most {{max}}.

graphs.topHint: The largest get their own colour, up to {{max}}; the rest add up to Other.
graphs.cumulativeHint: Adds up from the start of the period.
graphs.accountsHint: With one account, transfers in and out count as income and spending.
graphs.noPeriod: This period has no dates yet. Pick another one.
graphs.empty: Nothing to show for this period.
graphs.coarsened: Shown per {{resolution}}: the screen is too narrow for the chosen resolution.
graphs.tooManyBars: Shown per {{resolution}}: a graph shows at most {{max}} bars.
graphs.tooManyPoints: Shown per {{resolution}}: a graph shows at most {{max}} points.
graphs.leftOut_one: {{count}} account in another currency isn't included.
graphs.leftOut_other: {{count}} accounts in other currencies aren't included.
graphs.topPieHint: The largest get their own slice, up to {{max}}; the rest add up to Other.
graphs.tooManySlices: Shown per {{resolution}}: a pie shows at most {{max}} slices.
graphs.belowZero_one: {{count}} below 0 isn't shown: a pie can't show it.
graphs.belowZero_other: {{count}} below 0 aren't shown: a pie can't show them.
graphs.showAsHint: An amount per day, week, month or cycle, by the days each interval covers so far, so periods of different lengths compare fairly.
graphs.noCycles: Per cycle needs cycles: shown as totals.
graphs.averageHint: A dashed line at the average of the intervals.

averageWhole.hour_one: The average is of {{count}} whole hour; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.hour_other: The average is of {{count}} whole hours; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.day_one: The average is of {{count}} whole day; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.day_other: The average is of {{count}} whole days; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.week_one: The average is of {{count}} whole week; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.week_other: The average is of {{count}} whole weeks; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.month_one: The average is of {{count}} whole month; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.month_other: The average is of {{count}} whole months; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.year_one: The average is of {{count}} whole year; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.year_other: The average is of {{count}} whole years; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.cycle_one: The average is of {{count}} whole cycle; partial ones don't count.
averageWhole.cycle_other: The average is of {{count}} whole cycles; partial ones don't count.

saved.label: Saved modules
saved.deleteText: Delete the saved module "{{name}}"? What it shows stays on screen.
saved.name: Name
saved.addHint: Adds "{{name}}" as a full-width widget at the end. It follows changes to the saved module.
saved.unsavedNote: The widget shows the saved module, not your unsaved changes.
saved.onDashboard_one: It's on the Dashboard in {{count}} widget, which will say the module was deleted.
saved.onDashboard_other: It's on the Dashboard in {{count}} widgets, which will say the module was deleted.
saved.max: You have {{max}} saved modules, the most there can be. Delete one to save another.
saved.periodHint: Over any period, the last N days, weeks or months too. In a report, the report's period applies.

admin.intro: Everyone who can log in. Users are never deleted: deactivate them instead, which keeps their data. Admins manage users, but don't see other users' money.
admin.usernameRule: 3–32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
admin.ownAccount: This is you. Change your own password in Settings.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.question: {{name}} can no longer log in, and is logged out everywhere. Their data is kept, and you can activate them again later.

reset.title: Reset the password for {{name}}?
reset.question: The password of {{name}} stops working at once, and they're logged out everywhere.

password.title: Temporary password
password.onceOnly: This is the only time it's shown. Give it to them; they must change it when they log in.

credential.label: How they get in
credential.linkHint: They open it, choose their own password and are logged in. It works once, for 24 hours.
credential.passwordHint: You give them a password, and they change it when they log in.

link.title: Link for {{name}}
link.intro: Send this link to {{name}}. They open it, choose their own password and are logged in.
link.onceOnly: It works once, until {{when}}. This is the only time it's shown; a new link or password voids it.

logs.intro: Warnings, errors, app events (startup, migrations, cycles, scheduled transactions) and admin actions. Ordinary requests are only in the server's own log. Paste an error's reference to see everything about that request.

retention.title: How long entries are kept
retention.intro: Older entries are deleted within the hour. Admin actions are usually kept the longest.

codes.above_capacity: That would take the bucket above its capacity.
codes.account_has_buckets: Buckets use this account as their source. Choose a new source account for each, or delete them in Bucket setup.
codes.active_cycle_exists: Another cycle is active. End it first.
codes.already_refilled: The bucket has already been refilled in this cycle.
codes.already_resolved: It has already been approved or skipped.
codes.balance_not_zero: The account still has money in it. Transfer it to another account or adjust the balance to 0.
codes.bucket_lines_locked: The transaction is outside the active cycle, so its bucket lines can't change. You can still change the bank amount, counterparty, description and tags.
codes.csrf: The request was refused because it didn't come from this app.
codes.currency_mismatch: Money and buckets can only move between accounts in the same currency.
codes.cycle_finished: A finished cycle can't be changed.
codes.cycle_not_active: Only the active cycle can be ended.
codes.cycle_overdue: The active cycle's end date has passed. Extend or end the cycle first.
codes.cycle_overlap: The cycle would overlap another cycle.
codes.export_too_new: This export is from a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
codes.goal_above_capacity: The goal can't be above the bucket's capacity.
codes.internal_error: The server ran into a problem.
codes.invalid_export: This file isn't a Bucky BudgetR export, or it's damaged.
codes.invalid_link: This link doesn't work. Ask an admin for a new one.
codes.last_admin: This is the last active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
codes.name_taken: That name is already in use.
codes.no_active_cycle: Bucket transactions need an active cycle. Start a cycle first.
codes.no_change: The balance is already this amount.
codes.not_correctable: System transactions of this type can't be corrected or reversed.
codes.not_enough_held: That much isn't held for the target on this account, or it wasn't held yet at that time.
codes.not_enough_unallocated: The account doesn't have that much unallocated money.
codes.not_found: It doesn't exist, or it has been deleted.
codes.not_fully_manual: Only a Fully manual bucket can be a savings target.
codes.not_next_cycle: An earlier cycle is planned. Start that one first.
codes.own_account: You can't change your own account here. Use Settings.
codes.pdf_failed: The report couldn't be made into a PDF. Try again.
codes.pdf_unavailable: PDF export isn't set up on this server, or its renderer can't be reached.
codes.refill_unavailable: Only income in the active cycle can trigger a refill.
codes.rule_overlap: The range overlaps another rule of the target.
codes.savings_transfer: This transfer moved held savings, so its amount and accounts can't change. Reverse it to put the money back on hold.
codes.too_many_renders: Other PDFs are being made. Try again in a moment.
codes.too_many_rules: The target has as many rules as it can (20).
codes.username_taken: That username is already in use.
codes.wrong_account_type: Only a savings, BSU, fund or investment account can be a savings target.
codes.wrong_refill_mode: Only buckets with the manual refill mode can be refilled by hand.

errors.tooManyAttempts_one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.tooManyAttempts_other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.

debug.title: Debug settings
debug.devOnly: Development only: production builds don't have these.

time.freezeHint: Time stands still instead of running on from the set moment.
time.affects: Moves the time for the whole server: accounts, buckets, cycles, refills and transactions. Logins keep the real time.

snapshots.name: Name
snapshots.oldSchemaHint: Taken before a database migration, so it can't be restored.
snapshots.restoreText: All your data (accounts, buckets, cycles, transactions and preferences) is replaced by the snapshot's.
snapshots.cloneText: It's {{user}}'s snapshot: you get a copy with new IDs.
snapshots.deleteText: Only the snapshot is deleted; your data stays as it is.

whatsNew.title: What's New
whatsNew.updated: Bucky BudgetR has been updated to {{version}}.

schedules.title: Scheduled transactions
schedules.empty: No scheduled transactions yet. Schedule one for later, or make one repeat: in New transaction, with Make recurring on a transaction, or with New schedule.
schedules.hidden_one: {{count}} more is hidden by the filters above.
schedules.hidden_other: {{count}} more are hidden by the filters above.
schedules.deleteConfirm: Delete this schedule? Its history goes too. The transactions it recorded stay.
schedules.resumedDone: Schedule resumed. It goes on from its next time; the times it missed aren't recorded.

modeHints.auto: It's recorded at its time, with its bucket lines in the active cycle.
modeHints.approve: It shows up in the approval queue on the Scheduled tab that many days before its time, so you can approve it early, and is overdue once its time has passed.

form.name: Name
form.pausedHint: Its times aren't recorded while it's paused. When it resumes, it goes on from the next time.
form.previewNone: No times left. Check the start and the end.
form.endBeforeStart: The end is before the start

queue.title: Waiting for approval ({{count}})
queue.notQueued: This scheduled transaction has already been approved or skipped.

reasons.outside_cycle: Its time was outside the active cycle
reasons.paid: Nothing was left to pay on the card's bill

notifications.emptyHint: Reminders and to-dos show up here: scheduled transactions to approve, bills coming up, balances to update, priority buckets that aren't covered and savings to move.

queue.body: Approve, edit or skip them on the Scheduled tab.

bill.expenseHint: Make sure the money's there, or pay it at the bank.
bill.transferHint: Remember to make the transfer at the bank.

balance.title: Update the balance of {{name}}
balance.body: A new cycle started {{date}}. Adjust the balance so the cycle starts from real numbers.

bucket.title: {{name}} isn't covered
bucket.body: This priority bucket is missing {{amount}}. Reallocate, or add money to its account.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.hint: What shows under Notifications. Each one goes away by itself once it's done.
settings.approval_queueHint: Scheduled transactions that ask first, or couldn't be recorded.
settings.upcoming_billsHint: Expenses and transfers a schedule records soon, to pay or move at the bank.
settings.investment_balanceHint: When a cycle starts: investment and fund accounts whose balance hasn't been updated.
settings.bucket_uncoveredHint: Priority buckets that aren't fully covered.
settings.savings_transferHint: Money held for savings targets, waiting for you to move it.
settings.savings_shortHint: A fixed savings amount the unallocated money didn't cover.
settings.bsu_over_limitHint: A BSU account whose deposits this year are over the yearly or total limit.
settings.bsu_withdrawalHint: Money a scheduled transaction took out of a BSU account.
settings.credit_limitHint: Credit cards with 90% or more of their limit used.
settings.card_billsHint: A credit card's bill: ready, due within the days ahead, and carried over when not paid in full.

savings.title: Money held for {{name}}
savings.body: {{amount}} is set aside. Make the transfer at the bank, then press Done.
savings.bodyBucket: {{amount}} is set aside on another account. Move it to the bucket's account, then press Done.

savingsShort.title: Saved less for {{name}}
savingsShort.body: {{account}} didn't have enough unallocated money, so the savings budget is {{amount}} short this cycle.
savingsShort.titleDistributor: Saved less for the savings distributor

bsu.overBody: This year's deposits are {{amount}} over the yearly or total BSU limit.
bsu.withdrawalBody: A scheduled transaction took {{amount}} out of the BSU account {{date}}, which can cost you the tax deduction.

card.nearBody: {{amount}} is owed on the card: 90% of its credit limit or more.
card.overBody: {{amount}} is owed on the card, more than its credit limit.

cardBill.readyBody: {{amount}} to pay by {{date}}, at least {{minimum}}. Finalize it once everything up to the statement day is entered.
cardBill.readyBodyMinimumPaid: {{amount}} left to pay by {{date}}. The minimum payment is paid. Finalize it once everything up to the statement day is entered.
cardBill.dueBody: {{amount}} is left to pay, at least {{minimum}}.
cardBill.dueBodyMinimumPaid: {{amount}} is left to pay. The minimum payment is paid.
cardBill.carriedBody: {{amount}} was left when it was due on {{date}} and carries over, {{minimum}} of it the minimum payment.
cardBill.carriedBodyMinimumPaid: {{amount}} was left when it was due on {{date}} and carries over to the next bill. The minimum payment was paid.

confirm.overBody: This takes a BSU account over this year's or the total deposit limit. Interest doesn't count as a deposit.
confirm.withdrawalTitle: Money out of a BSU account
confirm.withdrawalBody: This takes money out of a BSU account, which can cost you the tax deduction.

bsu.createHint: A BSU is in NOK. Right after you create it, you set up its history: what you've deposited each year.
bsu.currencyFixed: A BSU account is always in NOK.
bsu.onlyNok: Only an account in NOK can be a BSU.
bsu.becomesBsu: As a BSU it's locked until you set up its history: what you've deposited each year.
bsu.leavesBsu: Its BSU history setup goes. If it becomes a BSU again, it must be set up again.
bsu.lockedOut: Locked BSU accounts are left out until their history is set up.

locked.title: Locked until set up
locked.body: Set up this BSU's history, what you've deposited each year, before recording anything with it. You can still delete it.
locked.notNok: This BSU is in {{currency}}, but a BSU must be in NOK. Change its type, or delete it.

setup.title: Set up BSU {{name}}
setup.intro: Enter what the bank shows for each year since you opened the account. The app rebuilds the account's transactions from it, once, and unlocks it. Its opening balance in the app isn't used.
setup.notNok: This BSU is in {{currency}}, but a BSU must be in NOK. Change its type in Account setup, or delete it.
setup.already: This BSU's history is set up already. Change it with ordinary corrections.
setup.openedHint: At the latest {{year}}, the year of its first transaction in the app.
setup.belowRecorded: At least {{amount}}, what the app has.
setup.overYear: {{amount}} over the yearly limit of {{limit}}. It's saved as given.
setup.overTotal: In all, {{amount}} over the total limit. It's saved as given.

plan.title: What it records
plan.nothing: Nothing to add: the app has it all.
plan.opening: The opening balance is corrected to 0 ({{amount}})
plan.adjustment: A balance adjustment of {{amount}} to match the bank
plan.once: It's done once, all at once. Later changes are ordinary corrections.

admin.intro: The BSU deposit limits by law. A year uses the rule from the latest year at or before it. Changes are logged, and users aren't told.
admin.lastRule: The last rule can't be deleted.
admin.saved: The BSU rule from {{year}} is saved.
admin.deleted: The BSU rule from {{year}} is deleted.
admin.totalBelow: The total limit can't be below the yearly limit.
admin.yearTaken: There's a rule from {{year}} already: saving changes it.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule from {{year}}? Its years use the rule before it.

confirm.title: Past the credit limit
confirm.body: This takes the credit card past its credit limit. The bank may have declined it, so record it only if it went through.

cards.createHint: A credit card owes money: its balance is below 0 while something is owed. Purchases are expenses on it, and payments are transfers to it.
cards.defaultAccountHint: Optional. Where purchases that aren't paid from a bucket set the money aside, and what the bill is paid from, unless you choose otherwise. Usually your main usage account.
cards.noChoices: No usage or savings account in {{currency}} yet, so it has none for now.
cards.statementDayHint: The day each month the bill is made. It covers what's owed by the end of the day before.
cards.dueDayHint: The day each month the bill is due: the first one after the statement day.
cards.minimumHint: A fixed amount. A smaller bill is paid in full.
cards.owedHint: What the card owes, as the bank shows it. A negative amount means it's in credit.
cards.typeFixed: A credit card stays a credit card.
cards.notToCard: An account can't become a credit card. Create a new account for the card.
cards.stopsDefault: It stops being the default account of {{names}}.
cards.payOff: Pay it off from another account
cards.adjustToZeroHint: For debt that's gone, e.g. a card the bank has closed and settled.
cards.enterOwed: Enter what the bank shows as owed.

debt.title: Card debt
debt.releasesHint: The rest of the payment releases money set aside on other accounts, which becomes unallocated there.
debt.nothingToSetAside: There's nothing to set aside: all that's owed is set aside, or no account can hold it.
debt.nothingHeld: Nothing is set aside for this card.
debt.setAsideIntro: Holds part of what {{card}} owes on an account, out of its unallocated money, until the bill is paid.
debt.releaseIntro: Gives money set aside for {{card}} back to the account, as unallocated.
debt.overRest: At most {{amount}} in all: the part of the payment it doesn't clear.
debt.overAmount: At most the amount transferred, in all.
debt.setAsideOnHint: What's not from buckets ({{amount}}) is held there until the bill is paid.
debt.refundHint: What's not to buckets ({{amount}}) lowers what's set aside there.
debt.noBuckets: No buckets are funded from accounts in {{currency}}.
debt.deleteCard: The {{amount}} set aside for it is cleared by the payment or released.
debt.deleteCarried: Its card debt ({{held}}) moves with the money to {{name}}.

cards.needsDefault: Auto-finalize pays from the default account. Choose one first.

pay.title: Paying the bill
pay.hint: What Finalize bill starts from, and what auto-finalize does.
pay.amountHint: At most what's left on the bill.
pay.autoFinalizeHint: On the payment day, finalize the bill with the app's amount and pay it from the default account as set here.
pay.autoFinalizeNeeds: Needs a default account to pay from.

bill.title: Bill
bill.label: {{name}}'s bill
bill.estimateHint: Worked out from the transactions entered. Finalize it once everything up to the statement day is entered.
bill.carried: Carried over to the next bill.
bill.firstOn: No bill yet. The first statement is made on {{date}}.
bill.previousLeft: {{amount}} was left on the statement of {{date}} and carried over.

payment.title: Payment
payment.queued: {{amount}} from {{from}} on {{date}} waits for your approval.
payment.applied: The scheduled payment from {{from}} was made.

bill.bankHint: Check it against the bank's statement.
bill.bankDiffers: The app has {{app}}. Finalizing adjusts the card by the difference just before {{date}}.
bill.paysLater: Pays {{amount}}, or what's left by then.
bill.finalizedScheduled: {{card}}'s bill is finalized and its payment scheduled.
bill.setupIntro: The bill was added after this card. Tell the app about its last statement, so it knows what's left to pay.
bill.setupHas: Has the card had a statement yet?
bill.lastPaidHint: Optional. What you've paid on it after the statement.
bill.setupAmount: Enter an amount of 0 or more.
bill.lastStatementHint: Optional. If the card has had a statement, its amount, so the app knows what's left to pay. Without one, the first bill is the next statement day's.

scheduleNote.full: This pays what's left on {{card}}'s bill when it's recorded. It stays a transfer to the card; a different amount pays that, at most what's left.
scheduleNote.minimum: This pays the minimum left on {{card}}'s bill when it's recorded. It stays a transfer to the card; a different amount pays that, at most what's left.
scheduleNote.fixed: This pays its amount on {{card}}'s bill, at most what's left when it's recorded. It stays a transfer to the card; a different amount pays that, at most what's left.

bill.pastDue: Past due: the minimum payment isn't paid. What's left carries over.
